Cyber Security Professional

Ballerup

Your impact begins here

As Cyber Security Professional in Security Architecture, you will help turn security requirements into practical designs for the technology and manufacturing environments Novo depends on. You will support architecture reviews, identify risks and recommend improvements that are proportionate and usable. Working alongside experienced architects, you will build on your technical foundation and take on broader responsibility as your experience grows. Your work helps colleagues make sound security decisions while innovation keeps moving.

What you’ll bring

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information security, computer science with a cybersecurity focus, or a closely related cyber discipline. You also bring:

• 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, systems engineering or a similar technical role.

• Practical experience in one or more relevant areas, such as Windows or Linux servers, endpoint security, Active Directory, network security, Zero Trust architectures, cloud platforms or manufacturing systems.

• A sound understanding of core security principles, including least privilege, secure configuration, segmentation and defence in depth.

• The ability to analyse technical problems, document your findings and communicate recommendations clearly.

• Good collaboration skills and professional proficiency in English.

We do not expect expertise in every domain. We are looking for someone who can apply an established technical foundation, ask thoughtful questions and grow into broader architecture responsibilities.

Useful, but not essential:

• Cybersecurity qualifications or certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, SSCP, Microsoft security certifications or equivalent.

• Exposure to industrial cybersecurity, AI security or security architecture.

• Familiarity with standards such as ISO 27001 and IEC 62443.

What you’ll do

Your work will span servers, endpoints, Active Directory, Zero Trust Security Architecture, Manufacturing Security, AI and cloud platforms. You will bring hands-on experience in some of these areas and develop your knowledge across the others, with support from colleagues.

• Support security architecture reviews of new systems and changes to existing ones, identifying risks and recommending proportionate, practical improvements.

• Contribute to security reference architectures, design patterns, standards and technical guidance that others can reuse.

• Work with infrastructure, application, cloud and manufacturing teams to embed security into solution designs.

• Support the design and assessment of Zero Trust Security Architectures, including network segmentation, secure access, and access decisions informed by identity and device security.

• Assess security considerations for emerging technologies, including AI services and applications.

• Document design decisions and explain security recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.

You will take ownership of defined tasks and progressively lead smaller architecture assessments as your experience grows.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Security Architecture department within Cyber Risk and Resilience, part of Enterprise IT & Quality. In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

Day to day, you will work alongside experienced architects, and with infrastructure, application, cloud and manufacturing teams. Security Architecture helps Novo make sound security decisions across technology and manufacturing environments, giving colleagues across the organisation clear direction, reusable designs and practical advice that support resilience and innovation.

What you can expect here

You will join a developing function where you can contribute ideas, challenge established approaches constructively and help shape how we work. You will be trusted with ownership of defined tasks from the start, and supported by colleagues as you deepen your expertise across new domains such as Zero Trust, manufacturing security and AI.

As your experience grows, so does your scope: you will move from supporting reviews to leading smaller architecture assessments, building a broader architecture skill set along the way.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600.00 to 734,400.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn security principles into practical designs that help Novo move forward securely, apply for the Cyber Security Professional role by 20 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Job Title: Management Coordinator (Maternity Cover)

Your impact begins here

As Management Coordinator (Maternity Cover), you will keep management support running smoothly across budgets, HR, meetings, events and communication in API Quality M1 and API Quality M2. You will act as the extended arm of management, making sure decisions are executed, changes are finished properly and processes keep improving. Your work gives leaders room to focus on priorities and gives colleagues clarity on what happens next, so the department keeps moving with pace and quality. Whether you see this as the next step in your career or as a one-year development opportunity, you will have the chance to learn, build your network and make an impact.

What you’ll bring

You bring a service mindset, sound business understanding and the initiative to keep things moving.

• 
Office education or another relevant education.

• 
A high level of business understanding.

• 
A strong service mindset and the ability to build and use networks.

• 
Readiness for change, and the confidence to support others through it.

• 
Independence and initiative in prioritizing, planning and carrying out tasks, whether assigned by management or started by you.

• 
Fluency in English, as you will work with colleagues and stakeholders across the department.

• 
Experience supporting a management team or director in a coordination or assistant role.

• 
Familiarity with the most common Novo systems, budget follow-up or HR processes.

What you’ll do

This is a broad role that sits close to management. You will make sure budgets, people processes, communication and planning all work together, and that decisions turn into action.

• Act as the extended arm of management and a trusted sparring partner. You will drive and support change management processes, take part in transformation initiatives and make sure changes are implemented and finalized correctly and timely.

• Support management with communication tasks by preparing, proofreading and refining presentations, announcements and all other communication materials.

• Secure timely budget and manning preparations and monthly follow-ups for the departments. You will also plan and take part in various budget meetings and handle all purchasing within your approval rights in Coupa.

• Be the key support on HR processes such as promotions, organizational changes, contract handling, onboarding and personal cases, including acting as power of attorney for directors and managers in relevant systems.

• Plan the director’s annual calendar, department meetings and events across API Quality and drive the management team’s annual cycle activities across the departments.

• Ad hoc administrative tasks, such as taking part in the secretariat during inspections and audits, contribute to relevant projects, and give daily support to colleagues and stakeholders, guiding them to help themselves.

Who you’ll work with

You will join API Manufacturing Quality, where colleagues collaborate across the Novo Nordisk value chain to support high quality and responsible ways of working.

In this role, you will support two departments (approx. 40-50 employees each) called API Quality M1 and API Quality M2 and work closely directly with both management teams. The departments are around 40-50 employees each. You will join an engaged environment and collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, gaining insight into daily operations and the processes that support management decisions.

You will also be part of administrative networks across API Quality, API IO and EITQ, where you can exchange knowledge, share best practices and Identify opportunities to simplify and improve processes and ways of working.

The position is based in Kalundborg.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard. The role gives you room to use your initiative, improve procedures, quality and service, and grow your skills through projects and exchange with colleagues in the networks. You will contribute where decisions are made, with clear expectations and support to perform at your best.

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

Join our Identity & Access Management team and help keep a business-critical identity governance platform secure, stable and ready for the future. As our Senior IGA Engineer, you will combine deep SailPoint IdentityIQ expertise with a strong understanding of business needs and operational priorities. You will resolve complex incidents, shape sustainable technical solutions and help prevent recurring issues. Your work will enable colleagues across Novo Nordisk to access the systems and information they need securely and efficiently.

What you'll bring

You are an experienced identity governance professional who can connect technical detail with business impact. You take ownership across team boundaries, communicate clearly and approach complex problems with curiosity and pragmatism.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
At least five years of hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ, including responsibility for operating and supporting the platform.

• 
Strong knowledge of SailPoint IdentityIQ architecture, integrations and capabilities in a large, complex enterprise environment.

• 
In-depth knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including how these technologies interact with identity governance and administration services.

• 
Experience analysing business requirements and translating them into user stories, acceptance criteria and clear functional specifications for technical teams.

• 
A relevant degree in information security, computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 
Experience working with external vendors or outsourced service providers to resolve incidents and deliver sustainable improvements.

Experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud or another cloud-based identity governance solution would be valuable. We would also welcome experience with cloud migration planning, regulated industries, controlled change processes, audit expectations or the governance of non-human identities, including AI agents and machine workloads.

What you'll do

• 
Act as the third-line escalation point for complex SailPoint IdentityIQ incidents that cannot be resolved by first- or second-line support.

• 
Lead technical investigations with developers, identity governance architects and external service providers, identifying root causes and coordinating practical recovery options.

• 
Assess proposed fixes and workarounds for operational and security risks, then drive improvements that strengthen platform stability and reduce recurring incidents.

• 
Support major incident resolution by providing technical expertise, assessing business impact and communicating clear options to technical and business stakeholders.

• 
Analyse business needs and clarify their implications for identity processes, data flows, integrations and ongoing operational support.

• 
Work with the IGA Product Owner and development team to refine the backlog, clarify requirements, evaluate proposed solutions and validate that delivered changes meet business and operational needs.

You will also help maintain standard operating procedures and strengthen the operational knowledge base. Through knowledge transfer, clear escalation guidance and improvements to support processes, you will enable first- and second-line support teams to resolve more issues consistently and effectively.

You will join the Identity & Access Management department within Infrastructure in Enterprise IT. The department is responsible for the full identity and access management landscape, covering strategy, development, daily operations and continuous improvement.  Your closest partners will include the IGA Product Owner, IGA architects, developers and the support team.  You will also collaborate with external service providers and colleagues across different Lines of Business.

What you can expect here

This is an onsite role in Ballerup where you can apply your technical expertise to a platform that supports secure access across a large and complex organisation. You will have the opportunity to influence operational practices, contribute to the continued development of our identity governance capabilities and build knowledge across the wider support organisation.  You will work in an environment where collaboration, professional curiosity and clear communication matter. The role offers exposure to both immediate operational challenges and emerging identity governance needs, including cloud-based platforms and non-human identities.

Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

Our IoT team builds the devices and edge software that connect our customers' production lines to the Factbird platform, from sensors on the line to industrial edge computers running computer vision right next to the machines. We're a small team with broad ownership, and we're hiring an Embedded Platform Engineer to help build and run the platform our edge products stand on.

**This role is onsite in Copenhagen, Denmark. We welcome applications from candidates based in Spain who are open to relocating to Copenhagen.

**

About the Role

As Embedded Platform Engineer, you'll work hands-on across Factbird EDGE, our industrial edge platform, together with the rest of the IoT team: the operating system, the device software, and the vision models that run on it. You'll take ownership of the infrastructure around the devices: provisioning and recovery, over-the-air updates, and fleet observability, the systems that keep our unattended devices reliable, secure, and safely updatable in factories you may never visit.

You'll work in Rust on embedded Linux, with Yocto, AWS IoT Greengrass, GStreamer and ONNX Runtime at the core, alongside our Cloud and DevOps engineers and the people building our AI capabilities. Part of the job is shaping the role with the team as our edge products grow.

You'll thrive here if you like working across a system end to end, from the bootloader to the cloud connection, and if you'd rather fix the root cause in the build than patch around it on the device.

What you'll do

Embedded Linux & the EDGE platform

• Develop our Yocto-based Linux distribution: layers, BSPs, kernel configuration, and reproducible builds

• Build and maintain the Rust components that run on our edge devices

• Bring up new hardware platforms, debug on target, and keep the platform secure and maintainable over a long device lifetime

• Keep our CI and on-hardware testing healthy, so changes reach devices with confidence

Edge inference & vision

• Work with our ML and vision engineers on the device side of our computer vision capabilities: camera pipelines, video streaming, and model inference that runs efficiently on industrial hardware

• Share ownership with our ML engineers of how trained models move from our model pipeline onto devices and how they perform there: packaging, rollout, rollback, and drift monitoring

• Help bring new edge runtimes for vision workloads from development into production

Fleet infrastructure & ownership

• Own device provisioning, over-the-air updates, and fleet observability

• Make deployments to devices in the field safe and boring: staged rollouts, health checks, and recovery paths

• Help diagnose issues on devices at customer sites, working with Support, Product, and Cloud to turn them into lasting fixes

• Share knowledge in both directions: learn the parts of the platform others built, and make sure what you build doesn't live only in your head

**What we're looking for

**

We're looking for an engineer who has shipped embedded Linux into production and lived with it afterwards: someone who has debugged a device they couldn't touch, and who wants real responsibility rather than a ticket queue.

You work independently, but you don't work alone. You can take a loosely defined problem and move it forward without daily direction, and you pull others in early, because on a small team the best fix is one more than one person understands. You're disciplined where it matters, in releases and rollouts, and curious where it pays off, in vision and new hardware.

You don't need everything below. Yocto is the core. Rust matters, but strong C/C++ engineers who have started with Rust are welcome too. The rest you can grow into with us.

**

The ideal background**

• Hands-on experience shipping embedded Linux to production, including Yocto: layers, BSPs and images you've built and maintained yourself, not just consumed

• Strong systems programming in Rust, or deep C/C++ experience on embedded Linux and real exposure to Rust that you want to build on

• An advantage if you have worked with AWS IoT Core or Greengrass, video pipelines or ML inference on edge hardware, or in industrial settings where devices run unattended for years

• A solid grasp of embedded security and update mechanisms: signed images, A/B or similar update schemes, and secure device provisioning

• You can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer, Support or a customer, and you do it in fluent English

• We welcome applications from people eager to move to Denmark, as long as you already have the legal right to live and work here.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s mechanical design capability for antenna and RF systems. The role is intended for an experienced mechanical engineer with prior hands-on experience developing the mechanical implementation of antenna, RF, or microwave hardware.

You will design and develop mechanical solutions for antenna systems and associated RF and electronic assemblies. The work includes antenna supports and mounts, RF-aware enclosures, radomes, fixed and, where applicable, deployable antenna mechanisms, test fixtures, thermal solutions, connector integration, cable routing, sealing, environmental protection, and platform interfaces. Many of these structures can directly affect antenna and RF performance, requiring close co-design with antenna and RF engineers.

The role covers mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing-process selection, structural and thermal analysis, tolerance definition, detailed CAD design, prototyping, assembly, environmental validation, serviceability, and production release. Particular attention will be given to mechanical structures that directly affect antenna performance, integration, alignment, stability, and deployment.

You will work closely with antenna systems engineers, RF and microwave hardware engineers, system architects, RF test and characterization engineers, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams. The role requires strong mechanical design expertise, RF-aware product thinking, end-to-end technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototype build and qualification to documented, manufacturable antenna assemblies and integrated systems.

• Translate system, antenna, and platform requirements into mechanical architectures, interface definitions, design constraints, and technical trade-offs.

• Design mechanical components and assemblies for antenna systems, including supports, mounts, frames, radomes, RF-aware enclosures, fixed or deployable mechanisms, and platform-integration structures.

• Own the detailed mechanical implementation of antenna and RF assemblies, including 3D CAD models, 2D manufacturing drawings, GD&T, assembly-level tolerance analysis, BOMs, and configuration-controlled documentation.

• Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance.

• Design test fixtures, alignment tools, handling aids, assembly tooling, and prototype-support hardware for antenna and RF system development.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in quantitative genetics and genomics with a focus on inbreeding depression and genetic diversity management

jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for an exciting two-year postdoctoral position in the field of quantitative genetics and genomics applied to inbreeding management in livestock populations. The primary focus of this position is to investigate the genetic bases of inbreeding depression in dairy cattle.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a two-year position starting on 1 April 2027, or as soon as possible. 

Job description
This is an opportunity to integrate a top research environment and contribute to advancing the state of the art in inbreeding management, while working within a collaborative project involving key industry partners.

The overarching objective of the project is to quantify the impact of inbreeding depression load on economically important traits in dairy cattle breeds and to investigate whether recessive variants contributing to inbreeding depression segregate in genomic regions experiencing rapid accumulation of inbreeding. Particular attention will be given to regions surrounding monogenetic traits (e.g. polled locus, milk caseins) which have been subjected to strong selection pressure in recent years.

You will apply state-of-the-art quantitative genetic and genomic modelling approaches to evaluate the effect of inbreeding depression on a broad range of production and functional traits recorded in dairy cattle populations. To support these analyses, you will have access to extensive databases containing phenotypic records routinely collected on farm, as well as large-scale pedigree and SNP genomic datasets currently used in genomic evaluations. High-density SNP genotyping and whole-genome sequence data will also be available to search for causal variants and more finely describe the genetic architecture of inbreeding depression in dairy cattle. Ultimately, the project aims to incorporate these findings into practical mating software readily available to dairy farmers. Therefore, these activities will be carried out in close collaboration with industry partners to ensure practical implementation in the field. 

Within this position, the successful candidate will also have the opportunity to contribute to other research projects related to genetic diversity management and quantitative trait modelling across other livestock species. 

Your profile
• A Ph.D. in Quantitative Genetics, Population Genetics or similar.
• Good programming skills (R, Python or Julia)
• Experience in the use of software to estimate variance components is a plus (e.g. DMU, BLUPF90 or similar) 
• A team player and a good communicator
• A good track record of publication in international peer-reviewed journals
• Fluent in English (written and spoken)
Who we are
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer
The successful candidate will be offered: 

• An interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across disciplines and diverse applications (livestock, plants and biomedicine).
• An international research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion.
• Computational resources, including access to the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment 

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus C (Denmark).

Contact information
For further information, please contact Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Alban Bouquet, +45 2070 2677, alban.bouquet@qgg.au.dk
Associate Professor Zexi Cai, +45 8715 7928, zexi.cai@qgg.au.dk

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.
